idea-plugin.name: Mantra Language Support
idea-plugin.description:
Official IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, CLion, and RustRover plugin for the Mantra Programming Language. Features:
  • File type recognition (*.mantra)
  • LSP-powered syntax highlighting and semantic token coloring
  • IntelliSense, Auto-complete and Signature Help
  • Go to Declaration, Implementation, and Find Usages
  • Compiler-backed Diagnostics and Quick Fixes
  • Code formatting matching 4-space Mantra indentation standard
